name: mdocs
description: Durable initiative and wiki memory for Kimi Code — MCP tools, workflow-enforcement hooks, skills, and an orchestrator agent.

interface.shortDescription: Initiative and wiki memory with enforced workflow gates

args: const path = require('node:path'); const home = process.env.KIMI_CODE_HOME || path.join(require('node:os').homedir(), '.kimi-code'); require(path.join(home, 'plugins', 'managed', 'mdocs', 'dist', 'mcp-server.js')).startMcpServer().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
